lines.text: Many learners say: I want a coffee, please.
Better: I would like a coffee, please.
Would like! I would like a tea, please.

data.right: I would like a coffee, please.
data.memory: I would like a coffee, please.

quiz.stem: In a shop: I ___ a tea, please.

native.tip: Türkçede “bir kahve istiyorum” kibardır; İngilizcede “I want” sert durur, “I would like” kibardır: “I would like a coffee, please.”
native.caption: “I want a coffee, please” mi diyorsun? 😅 Sipariş verirken “I want” sert durur; “I would like” daha kibardır. Doğrusu “I would like a coffee, please.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “would like”. Sipariş verirken “I would like” de. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: “I want” sounds hard; say “I would like” to order: “I would like a coffee, please.”
en.caption: Do you say “I want a coffee, please”? 😅 In English I want can sound hard when you order, so we say I would like. The right sentence is “I would like a coffee, please.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
